messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool us-west-2-rt18 experiencing sustained queue growth and throttling. Autoscaler attempted scale but returned 'at-capacity'. 95th queue length 2100 -> alert threshold hit. root_ts=1732100000
ash: ack — I'm oncall, investigating now.
matt: 12:00 deploy completed for model 'v3-hotload-keepctx' to us-west-2 (deploy-bot reported success). Not sure if related but flagging.
vela: pulling up grafana + autoscaler logs. link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/pool-us-west-2-rt18
ash: noticed large jump in avg context size and kv cache footprint starting at ~12:01. queue length spiking with requests holding KV sessions longer.
vela: grabbing autoscaler logs:
```
2024-06-15T12:02:05Z autoscaler: evaluate -> desired=16 current=12 limit=12 reason="quota:gpu-pool-capacity-limit"
2024-06-15T12:03:12Z pool: queued=2100 active=12 avg_ctx_tokens=5200 token_throughput=3200
2024-06-15T12:06:40Z autoscaler: scale_attempt failed -> provider_quota_exceeded
```
ash: ok provider quota prevented scale. that explains 'at-capacity'.
ryan: can we enable burst from reserved-burstpool?
vela: reserved burstpool for us-west-2 currently exhausted (committed to other tenants). need emergency fallback.
matt: recommending two-pronged mitigation: 1) route heavy-context routes to fallback smaller model (v3-compact-quant) 2) enable short-lived KV eviction (evict prefixes > 4k tokens) to reduce slot hold time
ash: agree. will also open a temporary throttle on request length > 8k tokens for non-enterprise customers.
julia: I'll start drafting outbound to affected tenants (prod-search customers). Which customers are impacted?
ash: initial pager shows ~7 customer routes with elevated error/latency (search-prod-*, chatbot-x). probable impact: higher latency and 429s for tail traffic.
vela: deploying routing change now: `redwoodctl route update --match "context_tokens>4000 && tier!=enterprise" --to-model v3-compact-quant --reason "incident 1732100000"`
deploy-bot: route change accepted and applied in 6ms.
ash: enabling KV eviction feature gate for pool (will be reversible)
```
redwoodctl runtime feature-toggle --pool us-west-2-rt18 --enable kv-evict-temp --params evict_threshold=4000,ttl=90s
```
ryan: scaling request to cloud provider submitted: `cloudctl request-increase --resource gpus --region us-west-2 --amount 8 --ticket INC-1732100000` — provider ETA ~18 minutes.
matt: I'm going to take primary oncall for the next rotation window. ash handing off to me at 12:20. @matt please watch route changes and customer impact.
ash: handing off to matt — i've run a quick token-length histogram and applied immediate routing and eviction. will stay on channel until 12:15 then shift to follow-up.
lina: logging incident (INC-1732100000) and kicking off call at :bell: 12:10 for cross-team sync (SRE, Platform, Deploy, CS).
julia: pinging CS on affected customers: sending templated note and creating high-priority support threads.
vela: metrics after initial mitigations (12:08 -> 12:18):
```
12:08 queued=4200 avg_ctx=5200
12:12 queued=1500 avg_ctx=4700 (routing applied)
12:16 queued=800  avg_ctx=3200 (kv-evict in effect)
```
ash: good signal. latency 95p improved from 1.8s to 0.9s for routed traffic. still seeing some 429s on enterprise tiers — investigating why some enterprise routes didn't follow fallback routing.
matt: found policy mismatch in route-matcher for enterprise flag — pushing hotfix to matcher service.
vela: matcher deploy rolled at 12:22: `deploy-bot: matcher-service@2024.6.15-hotfix`
ryan: cloud provider approved +4 GPUs early at 12:30; scaling completed and nodes came up at 12:32.
ash: queue drained to ~120 by 12:40, we've removed emergency throttle and reverted KV-evict gate at 12:45.
julia: CS updates: customers A and C saw degraded latencies and some 429s between 12:01-12:30. outbound messages sent and support threads opened.
lina: incident classified P1 because autoscaler hit provider quota and the model rollout increased context retention. RCA expected.
matt: summary/outcome: immediate mitigations (route fallback + kv-evict + temporary throttles) reduced slot hold time and bought time until cloud capacity increased. primary action items: 1) revert model variant that preserves full long context by default or ship config to limit context copying 2) add proactive capacity buffer for hotload rollouts 3) improve autoscaler visibility on provider quota errors 4) run rollout canary with synthetic long-context load.
ash: handing off post-incident to SRE/Platform for follow-up. I'll coordinate on RCA write-up.
lina: assigning owners and creating postmortem doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-1732100000
ash: :thumbsup: closing on-call loop. will label incident as resolved once postmortem is in draft.
end-of-thread
